newsitem.title: UK: WH Smith under shareholder pressure-paper.
newsitem.headline: WH Smith under shareholder pressure-paper.

text.p: WH Smith finance director Keith Hamill has admitted that some large shareholders have placed pressure on the company to break up the British retail group, the Financial Times reported on Monday.
The newspaper said Hamill had denied that he had held formal talks with investors about a break-up.
Analysts put a break-up value of the group at about 1.5 billion pounds ($2.4 billion).
WH Smith's shares have dropped sharply over the past 12 months and were hit hard in June by the departure of chief executive Bill Cockburn to join British Telecom Plc.
The Financial Times said Hamill was a candidate for the vacancy although the finance director told the newspaper he had no plans to resign if he did not get the job of chief executive.
